articleTitle: An Exploration of Intelligent Deep Learning Models for Fine Grained Aspect-Based Opinion Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The World Wide Web, such as online communities, discussions, product reviews, and blogs, generate enormous amounts of information in the form of user opinions, feelings, and conflicts about a variety of topics. a variety of social events, items, companies, and political issues. Most viewpoint investments, especially those produced for industrial automation, necessitate powerful data engineering and syntactic word embedding without examining semantic interaction between aspect term and advised qualities, resulting in service interruption. We provide a unique deep learning model for fine-grained aspect-based opinion mining in this research. As a result, this paper reviewed and summarizes the multiple techniques for sentimental analysis using deep learning based on aspects.

articleTitle: IOT based LED Electronics board
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Any institution or organization, as well as public utility locations such as bus stops, railway stations, and parks, must have a notice board. However, adhering to different alerts daily is a challenging task. This notice display will require the attention of a separate person. Bulletin boards can effectively display detailed information to the public, but updating bulletin boards is difficult. This project involves a high-tech bulletin board with advanced features. A Node MCU will be used to restore the notice on the display site using Google voice assistant. The user can add, remove, or change the text at any time to suit his needs.

articleTitle: Sign Language Recognition using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: One of the ways to communicate with deaf and dumb individuals is through sign language. So, in order to speak with deaf and dumb people, one should learn sign language; yet, because not everyone can learn it, communication becomes nearly impossible. The goal of this study is to use machine learning to break through these communication hurdles. The majority of existing technologies rely on external sensors, which are out of reach for most people. We utilize OpenCV to take images and the CNN technique to train the machine, with the output being text. Many previous studies have offered methods for partial sign language identification, however this study intended for the full acceptance of American Sign Language comprises of 26 letters and 10 numbers. The majority of ASL letters are static, however few are dynamic. As a result, the goal of this research was to extract features from finger and hand motions in order to distinguish between static and dynamic gestures.

articleTitle: Performance Improvement of Partially-Shaded PV Modules Connected DC Micro grid Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: It intended to acquire SEPIC converters, which have been utilized in a variety of applications It has two major drawbacks, the first of which is that it places power semiconductor devices are subjected to high voltages, and secondly, the power switches must work very hard, resulting in low efficiency. Power semiconductor devices with a higher voltage rating should be used, especially for high voltage applications. When the voltage rating goes up, power MOSFETs tend to have a higher Rds(on) value. As a consequence of this, it results in a greater amount of conduction loss when the current level remains the same. Consequently, if the current is held constant, decreasing the voltage stress can improve efficiency. The dynamic performance is enhanced.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Flexible Solar Panel for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: To design and develop a Solar Powered system which enable "charging on drive" feature for an E-bikeAt present, the E-batteries bike’s are charged using a static charger, which is permanently installed in one place. When the battery warning light comes on, we have to find a charging station, which may or may not be close by. Using solar energy is a step in the right direction toward a more sustainable future because it is both safe and clean. Incorporating a lightweight (flexible) PV panel currently on the market, we bring the novel concept of "charging on drive" to promote E-Vehicle use. The variation of solar panel output power with respect to factors like insolation, temperature, and Vmp is something we're modeling mathematically in matlab.

articleTitle: Driver Drowsiness Detection and Alert System using YOLO
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Fatigue detection is a safety technology that prevents accidents that are caused by drivers who feel fatigued while driving. Every year the rate of injuries and accidents are increases due to fatigue around the world. In this paper, a module for Driver Fatigue Detection is presentedto limit the incidence of accidents caused by fatigued drivers. Here we propose an YOLO algorithm to find the drivers face and eye detection using Dlibs and alert when the driver is drowsy. Second, using the Dilib toolbox, and the landmarks and coordinates of the facial regions, Face Feature Triangle is a geometric area that we created (FFT). We make a Face Feature Vector (FFV) that having all of the data about each FFT's area and centroid. We utilise FFV as a metric to detect whether or not a driver is fatigued. Last, we create a sliding window to calculate the entropy of face data.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Predicting wide range of traffic congestion using deep learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Identifying traffic bottlenecks and devising solutions to the problem requires researchers and practitioners in transportation to understand how congestion in one place impacts the rest of the network. The dynamics of traffic congestion are often modelled using mathematical equations or simulation approaches. Most methods have flaws, such as unreliable assumptions and a time-consuming parameter calibration procedure. For example, ITS and the Internet of Things (IoT) have facilitated the collection of transportation data. This sets off a chain reaction of data-driven investigations into transportation anomalies.Deep learning theory is a potential technique for dealing with big, multidimensional datasets. For this research, deep learning theory will be used to analyze large-scale transportation networks. Recurrent Neural Networks and Restricted Boltzmann Machines are used to model and forecast the evolution of traffic congestion based on the GPS data from a cab. Numerical research was carried out in Delhi, India, to verify the method's efficacy and efficiency. Using a GPU-based parallel computing system, the forecast's accuracy might reach 88% in as little as six minutes. Congestion evolution trends are displayed using a map-based platform to identify weak links for proactive congestion reduction.

articleTitle: Smart Routing System in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The continued increase in greenhouse gas levels causes glaciers to melt, sea levels to rise, and rain forests to die. We must minimise our usage of fossil fuels in order to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Electric cars' energy storage systems play a crucial part in this scenario, allowing them to exchange energy with the grid or with the house, depending on the power need. The control framework of a bi-directional wireless charger for an electric car connected to the smart home grid is the subject of this research. Furthermore, it addresses an electric vehicle's charging and discharging control infrastructure under various loading scenarios. The control structure is based on phase synchronisation between active H-bridge primary and secondary converters, with phase shift technology doing the actual control. Finally, a method for achieving optimum power flow and efficiency while still satisfying the smart house criterion is explored.

articleTitle: Leaf Disease Detection Using Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The research has concentrated heavily on the utilization of computer vision tasks to identify and categorise phytopathogens. Despite the fact that because herbs are plants too and are prone to disease, the identification of herb diseases has been limited owing to a large amount of study focusing on plant illnesses. A parsley disease detection identification and classification algorithm has been developed in order to recognise and categorise the parsley leaf spot (PLS) sickness according to severity. With 99.5 percentage accuracy rate in both binaries and inter of the PLS sickness, the suggested method employs a neural network convolutional (CNN)-based computational modeling (DL) model to detect 2000 real-time photographs of parsley leaves mixing healthy and PLS unhealthy images. The proposed model beats state-of-the-art pre-trained models in terms of multi-classifying PLS disease, as shown by comparisons between them and the proposed approach.

articleTitle: DBN with a Developed Version of Thermal Exchange Optimization (TEO) Model for Skin Cancer Detection and Classification
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The fact that melanoma is defined as an incurable illness in its advanced stages highlights the criticality of early detection and treatment. Various procedures and equipment have been utilised to detect this type of cancer early, practically all of which necessitated a doctor’s visit and were unavailable to the general public. This study proposes a generalizable, automated, and accurate method for discriminating benign pigmented skin lesions from malignant melanoma that does not require specialised imaging equipment or settings. DBN (Deep Belief Networks) and the Developed Version of Thermal Exchange Optimization are used to automatically classify and identify skin lesions (TEO). It is the major purpose of this model to diagnose and categorise distinct forms of skin cancer using thermoscopic imagery. Hair and noise can be eliminated from digital photos using the Dull razor and the average median filtering. The Tsallis entropy-based segmentation approach can also be applied to dermoscopic images to segment them. A COAbased feature extractor is utilized to extract topographies from segmented grazes using a capsule network (CapsNet), CAL, and the Adagrad optimizer. Following this stage, the DBN-TEO algorithm is used to classify the data. To see how well the DBNTEO algorithm works, it is compared to the ISIC dataset. One of our methods outperformed others in a wide variety of metrics.

articleTitle: Machine Learning based Diabetes Prediction using with AWS cloud
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: ML has contributed towards opening up new frontiers in several sectors including health and medical facilities. Multiple ML approaches has been designed and developed to execute prediction oriented analysis on big data acquired from several devices. Performing analysis through prediction is critical and daunting yet eventually it can aid and assist medical professionals and healthcare providers to arrive at strategic and wise assessments that could prove to be effective during prognosis as well as diagnosis at the time of patients’ treatments. This study takes into account the notion of analysis based on prediction especially in healthcare domain where ML algorithms are utilized to perform the necessary research. To validate and evaluate our proposed research, a training dataset comprising of patient’s health records are acquired and 6 diverse ML algorithms are employed on it. Analysis of performance and effectiveness of the ML algorithms and their comparative efficiency in prediction of diabetes has been elaborated and discussed in detail. Evaluation of the various ML approaches helps towards understanding the suitability of reliable ML algorithm that could be utilized for predicting diabetes and the associated symptoms. This study is thus aimed at assisting medical practitioners and health personnel to detect the diabetes earlier through application of appropriate ML methods. These algorithms utilised are artificial neural networks(ANN) , XG boosting ,Ada boosting, K Nearest Neighbours (KNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Tree (DT) . Through comparing and validating the above mentioned machine learning techniques facilitates the prediction of diabetes by means of an application where the users can enter the relevant details and acquire prediction based results.

articleTitle: A Novel Machine Learning Approach of Multi-omics Data Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: An integrated (combined) approach is needed in today's biomedical research in order to effectively use this data and obtain insights into natural systems. Genome, proteome, and metaproteomic data may be used to comprehend the complexities of molecular genetics utilising "machine learning" performance tracking methods derived from diverse omics sources. New biomarkers may be discovered by merging and analysing omics data using machine learning techniques. These biomarkers may aid in the proper identification of illness, the separation of patients, and the provision of tailored therapy. This study looks at a variety of "integrative machine learning or ML techniques" that are being used to obtain a better understanding of biological systems during natural bodily performance as well as when systems are diseased.Secondary data collection method has been used for this paper to gather relevant and factual data related to ML techniques of multi omics data prediction.

articleTitle: Prediction of Chronic kidney cancer using RBF support vector machine compared with Random forest for better accuracy
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research is to predict chronic kidney cancer using RBF SVM compared with random forest algorithm. Materials and Methods: A total of 280 samples are collected from the Vermont Center for Ecostudies (VCE) repository. These samples are divided into two types. They are training samples (n=750 (75 %)) and test samples (n=250 (25 %)). For the total sample size, the minimum power (G-Power) required is 0.8. Accuracy is calculated by a novel RBF SVM algorithm. Results: The value 0.8 is taken as G power. Novel RBF SVM obtained accuracy, recall and F-score of 99.0 %, 98.3 % and 98.9 % and Random forest achieved 98.0 %, 97.2 % and 98.3 %. The significance value is less than 0.05. Conclusion: From results it is observed that proposed radial basis function support vector machine algorithm is good in performance compared with random forest algorithm.

Author Keywords: Novel Radial basis function support vector machine algorithm

articleTitle: Wireless Communication Design Using Neural Networks and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: According to this report, the most innovative and active area of the communications business is wireless communications. Data may be sent wirelessly between two places without the need of physical media like wires or cables. Business network providers have had to adjust and adapt as a result of the big data age. Computer science, which is used in a variety of industrial and scholarly scientific fields, is one of the effective AI technologies for analysing this flood of data. This article goes in-depth on big dataset processing, technological breakthroughs, and potential 5G network service usage. Identify the needs of phone users using sophisticated analytics, and then apply that knowledge to increase the effectiveness of "shared wireless communications." Particularly striking is the extensive, comprehensive, data-driven computer vision framework it provides, which covers extraction of features, simulation models, and forecast enhancements. The proposed framework's main advantages include its reliance on a sizable data set that faithfully captures the spectrum and other demanding user requirements, the logic of robust computational models, the formulation of issues in the context of wireless networks, and the capacity to design a method. Through a communication system, data is often sent from the transmitter to the receiver across very long distances. Through wireless communication, the transmitter may be positioned anywhere within a few metres. We'll examine existing strategies, their advantages and disadvantages, as well as upcoming developments in underwater sensor networks. We have discovered a fresh approach to doing research.

articleTitle: A novel Deep CNN based LDnet model with the combination of 2D and 3D CNN for Face Liveness Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Face anti-spoofing plays a very important role in security applications using face recognition in their system. Numbers of imposters are involved in spoofing methods. To ensure the presence of real human face in the security system, liveness detection is developed. Recently, many research studies have focused on printed/ photo imposter faces. But this work concentrated on finding face anti-spoofing using both photo and video imposters. In this paper, a novel Deep Convolution Neural Network (CNN) based Liveness Detection network (LDnet) using the combination of both 2D CNN and 3D CNN is proposed. As a pre-processing step, HOG (Histogram of Oriented Gradients) face detector is used to extract the face region from the given input images. The extracted face images are fed into the proposed LDnet model with 15 CNN layers to learn the features while training operation. Finally, the learned features are tested for face liveness detection to predict the real and imposter faces correctly. It is found that the performance of the proposed LDnet model using ROSE-YOUTU database gives better accuracy of 99.79% and HTER (Half Total Error Rate) of 0.08% than other existing methods.

articleTitle: Prediction of Heart Disease using Decision Tree in Comparison with KNN to Improve Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Aim: The aim of this survey is to use the irregular forest method to forecast cardiac disease and to achieve better forecasting accuracy by implementing machine learning algorithms and comparing their performance to KNN. In this research, two groups—Decision Tree and K-Nearest Neighbor—are examined. The strategies have been put into practice and tested using a dataset with 1700 records. N=20 iterations on each method are run as part of the programming experiment to identify different grades of model performance with a repeated measures power of 80%. Following testing, the decision tree method and the k-nearest neighbor approach both achieve mean effectiveness of 86.7 percent and 82.5 percent, respectively, for the disease prediction. By using independent samples t-tests, it can be shown that the accuracy of the two algorithms differs statistically significantly (p 0.05). The results of the comparison demonstrate that the Random Forest algorithm performs noticeably better than KNN.

articleTitle: Nexus of Water Quality prediction by ANN
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Various contaminants, threatened water quality in recent years. Predicting and model construction for checking water quality have become crucial to control water pollution. Parameters such as water quality indexing (WQI) and water quality categorization has taken for measuring the level of quality. Artificial neural network models (ANN by NARNET and long short-term memory (LSTM) deep learning algorithm, usedto predict water quality indexing. For WQC forecasting, three machine learning techniques is applied to analysis seven water quality factors. Performance of Water quality estimation is compared in both NARAT and LSTM in terms of accuracy.

articleTitle: IOT based Smart solution for Traffic congestion at Metro Cities
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The major challenge in metro cities is to handle the vehicle traffic as well as pedestrian traffic at major locations. Over a day nearly 20% time is spend in our work or personal time to over come the delay at traffic to reach the destination. Traffic management systems have been the subject of much study, but because of the blending of technologies like the Internet of Things (IoT) and artificial intelligence, research on intelligent traffic monitoring is currently ongoing (AI). By integrating these technologies, we can improve decision-making processes and promote urban development. The management of urban and highway traffic is the primary emphasis of the available traffic prediction techniques, and there are few studies that have concentrated on collector roads and closed campuses. Furthermore, when the consumers are not using any smart gadgets, it is difficult to reach out to the public and create active relationships to help them make decisions. In order to gather, analyse, and store real-time traffic data for such a situation, this study suggests an IoT-based system paradigm. The goal is to increase mobility by using roadside messaging devices to provide real-time traffic reports on traffic congestion and unexpected traffic events. These time-saving alerts will benefit residents, particularly during rush hour. Also disseminated by the system are the administrative authorities' traffic updates. The results of the trials demonstrate high accuracy in vehicle recognition and a low relative error in road occupancy prediction. A prototype is used to assess the viability of the model. The research project, which is financed by Omani, is looking at Real-Time Feedback for Adaptive Traffic Signals.

articleTitle: OraB - A Community of Donors
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In today’s time healthcare is a sensitive subject for anyone living in any part of the world. Medical science works on enhancing the quality and period of life. To provide healthy life at times people might have to undergo surgeries or transplantation as well. The world has improved a lot in technologies and with the advancement; security in the process has been major concern. In times of need for organs or blood, it’s crucial to have a secure and transparent system. People tend to panic in the situation and information about organ or blood donors is not easily accessible when needed. Thus, in this paper a web application is proposed for both organ and blood donors in one place. Or(organ) and B(blood) together is combined to make OraB - a platform for building a community of donors. The aim is to make a decentralized web application that will be a reliable platform for connecting donee with the donors. As it’s a decentralized web app, it will draw out the involvement of a third-party networks completely. Vanilla JS has been used for the front-end, Web3.js has been used for the back-end, and its smart contract is made using javascript similar language solidity. This is a blockchain-based project which assures complete security and transparency in tracking the transaction of organ donation and is quite economical.

articleTitle: Machine Learning and Deep Transfer Learning approaches were used to create a Face Mask Identification model for COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: COVID-19 pandemic has led to an international health emergency the WHO considers wearing a face mask an appropriate form of public health protection. This work will describe a face mask identification model that incorporates both deep and traditional machine learning techniques. Parts of the suggested model can be divided into two. Using Resnet50, the initial part of the system is set up for feature extraction. The second component classifies face masks using decision trees, support vector machines (SVMs), and the ensemble approach. The research will focus on three face-masked datasets. The Real-World Masked Face Dataset Includes three datasets: real-world masked faces, simulated faces, and wild faces (LFW). 99.64% of RMFD's SVM classifier is accurate throughout testing.. It achieved a 99.49% accuracy rate in SMFD and a 100% accuracy rate in LFW.

articleTitle: Implementation of Virual Instrumentation for Signal Acquisition and Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: National Instruments collaborated on virtual instruments. The programme for instruments, "LabVIEW," allows users to have sophisticated equipment within the software while performing measurements in a laboratory or in the field. Engineers and researchers can even create their own instruments utilising software-simulated signals using virtual instruments. The development and application of programmable measuring systems has received a lot of attention. The ability to change the measurement technique simply by altering the algorithm implemented by the computer-based architecture without having to replace the hardware components simplifies the experiment. By using a visual interface, virtual measurement systems have been proposed to make the design, implementation, and usage of programmable measuring systems easier. Data Acquisition.

articleTitle: Security Issues in Blockchain Integrated WSN: Challenges and Concerns
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In cutting edge era the foremost valuable information is ‘Data’, and WSN system has become one in all the integrated elements of our life. From smart phones to shrewd watches, there’s tons of data creation in each and every moment and wireless sensors are one of the primary components of WSN framework. Wireless sensors are utilized in all the WSN systems in corporated gadgets like advanced mobile phones, watches, fitness tracker and so on., these sensors are easy to use and have numerous distinctive characteristics. WSNs are used for real time trailing and surveillance purposes, where the nodes collaborate with each other to pass and retrieve the information. However, there are chances of compromise of data, so security turns into a major issue in WSN. Blockchain is a secure database i.e., a ledger that monitors all transactions occurring. In this paper, an in-depth survey on blockchain integrated WSN is done and the security parameters are also dealt thoroughly.

articleTitle: Identifying the label of crisis related tweets using deep neural networks for aiding emergency planning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The extensive use of social media networks has resulted in the generation of huge real time data by the direct eyewitness of any major happening such as natural calamities, celebrations, manmade hazards, etc. This data seems to be ubiquitous, and immediately accessible by everyone. It may provide valuable information to Governments, disaster response organization and humanitarian organizations to speed up their recovery and relief process. However the presence of irrelevant or fake information, limitations of social media sites makes this process difficult. In this paper, the performance of Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) model which is used for detecting the informative type of crisis related tweets is analyzed and compared with both traditional Machine learning models and other deep learning models. We also evaluated the effect of using different word embeddings in deep learning classifiers. Our result shows that BERT outperforms all other models and also it is highly effective compared to other word embeddings.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Human Resource Management for Sales Research Perspective
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: "Artificial intelligence and Machine Learning" are some of the most versatile pieces of equipment that people use for the process of the organization and managing an organization and the workforce. Starting from Google, IBM to companies that are non-tech based such as Salesforce, Amazon and Walmart are all today using Artificial Intelligence to manage their employees. This includes their organization, allotment, and so on. For the purpose of conducting market research, the AI is also capable of managing the human resources for the most effective research process. The Machine Learning process comes after the collection of data happens for the obtainment of the results of the collected data. This data is used then to make future plans and courses of action for the organization.For the purpose of this study, research has been conducted in both primary and secondary methods. A detailed review of the literature has revealed the importance of the use of "Artificial Intelligence" and "Machine Learning" for the management of Human Resources to obtain maximum market research accuracy. The primary method has been done in the form of a survey. The survey has been conducted with professional marketing and market research personnel from various organizations. There were 51 participants and they were asked to answer two questions regarding the effectiveness of the AI and ML and the capability of AI and ML in achieving organizational goals and if they can assist the market researchers in their task. An overwhelming majority of them chose to agree.

articleTitle: Plant diseases detection using an improved CNN model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The share of agriculture in GDP has been raised to 20 percent in the year 2020-2021. 70 percent of the rural household depends on agriculture. 82 percent of farmers are small and marginal growers. It's necessary to maintain agricultural growth. The prolonged plant diseases affect the growth of food products.There is much research work carried out to predict plant diseases. Deep learning methods are providing better performance on trained data but don't predict diseases during testing. This work proposes an improved CNN model to detect plant diseasesduring testing and to provide better accuracy. The proposed model is trained with different hyperparameters like learning rate,solvers, batch size, and number of epochs. The proposed work is compared with existing methods like NASNet, DenseNet, and ResNet-18. The Improved convolutional neural network model outperforms in terms of accuracy. It provides 98.10% of accuracy whereas NASNet provides 71.31% of accuracy, DenseNet provides 98.01% of accuracy and ResNet 18 provides 97.5% of accuracy

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Segmentation and Survival Prediction using Multimodal MRI Scans with Deep learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Brain tumours developed by the brain’s abnormal cell growth. Medical imaging devices are classified into two types: MRI and CT are widely used to scan brain tumors. MRI images are used to scan the interior components of the brain. There are two types of brain tumours: benign and malignant. A benign brain tumour is one that can be cured, whereas a malignant brain tumour is one that cannot be cured. Gliomas and astrocytomas are two types of malignant brain tumours. A radiologist using conventional procedures to detect and diagnose a brain tumour. Errors and delays are all too common. Because neurosurgeons generate a large number of brain tumour images, imaging technicians are unable to manually categorise and segment them. It is not suitable for densely populated emerging markets. As a result, computer-aided automatic brain tumour detection and diagnosis is preferred. Learning algorithms, such as neural networks, are hampered by a lack of hyperparameter modification, several local optima, and higher computing time. Optimizing network architecture and hyperparameters is critical for avoiding these challenges. Deep learning optimization approaches are commonly employed in healthcare. This research proposed using Deep Learning Optimization Algorithms to detect and diagnose Meningioma brain cancer. This intended study addresses the extraction, categorization, and diagnosis of tumor picture segments.

articleTitle: Detection and analysis of emotion recognition from speech signals using Decision Tree and comparing with Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The aim of the study is to detect and classify emotions from speech signals using Decision Tree (DT) classifiers compared to Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifiers. Emotions are detected from speech signals using a DT and SVM classifier. The unique aspect of this research is the selection of salient elements from speech signals. The total sample size is 40. In the classification of eight different emotions, the DT classifier has a 35.90 % accuracy, whereas the SVM has a 27.18 % accuracy. There is a significant difference between the two groups, since p < 0.05 in SPSS Statistical analysis. From this work, it is observed that the accuracy obtained in detecting human emotions using the DT classifier is significantly better than SVM.

articleTitle: Technical analysis of crop production prediction using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Agriculture is a field that plays an important role in improving a country's economy, particularly in agricultural countries like India, where agriculture and crop productivity are important economic drivers. The study compares machine learning and deep learning algorithms in terms of forecasting overall agricultural output production. The study's criteria include the state name, district name, year, season, crop, area, and production. The dataset was obtained from the website data.gov.in. The R2 score is used to compare the performance of Random Forest from Machine Learning with the Sequential model from Deep Learning. The goal is to determine how well the independent variable predicts the variation in the dependent variable. Random Forest algorithm achieved an R2 score of 0.9, whereas Deep Learning Sequential algorithm gave an R2 score of 0.29.

articleTitle: Smart Electric vehicle charging Station for Residential Complex
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: We are very sophisticated in technology, living in a new era where artificial robots have reached Mars and some have also reached the solar system, but this is how humans survive until another Earth like a planet is no longer found. Means our responsibility to keep our planet clean and safe from global warming. When we talk about global warming, cars play an important role in increasing global warming, as they produce a lot of toxic gas that is harmful to our ecosystem. B. CO2, N2O. As shown in Figure 1 of India, the rate of air pollution by vehicles is 27%. That's quite a few, and most importantly, the fossil fuel supply is limited. Therefore, one needs to look for alternative fuels. Alternatively, using an electric vehicle (EV) is the best option. It is safe and does not generate gas. Also, there is no loud noise. The Government of India has also taken some steps to control pollution. They started several programs to promote the vehicle. Vehicles are already in use in some big cities, and their numbers are increasing every day. But the main problem is that there is no public charging station that can charge the vehicle. This article describes the concept of an intelligent charging system for unmanned aerial vehicles.

articleTitle: Implementation of Image Segmentation with Prewitt Edge Detection using VLSI Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Edge Detection is one of the discontinuity based image segmentation technique perform optimized function for detection, counting of people and other objects like vehicle, animals, etc in an image sequence. Edge detection is the technique bidding to designate the intensity changes concerned to the physical processes that have established them. Prewitt is one of the famous edge detection algorithms which use the derivative approximation to find the edges. This paper implements the Prewitt edge detection operator using VLSI design technique. Coding is written in VHDLand simulated using QUARTUS. The Simulation results are also compared with that of MATLAB outputs. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can be effectively used to detect objects in difficult videos of crowds with many occlusions, local noise and local scale variations.

articleTitle: Detection of Liver disorder using Quadratic Support Vector Machine in comparison with RBF SVM to measure the accuracy, Precision, sensitivity and specificity
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to compare the Quadratic SVM classifier’s performance with the RBF SVM method in identifying liver disorders. Techniques and Resources: Three datasets on liver illness that are available in Kaggle contain a total of 31035 samples. These samples are split into two groups: the training dataset (n = 23276; 75% of the total) and the test dataset (n = 7759; 25% of the total). Values for accuracy, precision, specificity, and sensitivity are calculated to estimate the SVM algorithm’s performance. Results: The accuracy, precision, sensitivity, and specificity of the quadratic SVM algorithm were 73.60 percent, 99.89 percent, 73.01 percent, and 96.87 percent, respectively, as opposed to the RBF SVM algorithm’s 73.32 percent, 97.97 percent, 77.27 percent, and 70.08 percent. In this research, it was discovered that the Quadratic SVM algorithm outperformed the RBF SVM algorithm in liver.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence-based Web-Centric E-health Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The tremendous growth in Information Communication Technologies (ICT) and the Internet of Things (IoT) propose new application domains like remote patient monitoring. Patient monitoring is mostly done through hospital systems, Remote patient monitoring systems will reduce cost and save travel time also it will increase the efficiency of the healthcare system. The main objective of our system is to develop an artificial intelligence-based e-Health monitoring system allowing the close monitoring of patient parameters without any location boundary. This system gives a multidimensional diagnosis system. It integrates web, mobile, and display technology. In the proposed system temperature, pulse rate, blood pressure, and sugar level are captured and stored in a database. The process is carried out by Raspberry Pi (ARM 11) integrated with sensors. A web-based application interface is created for real-time communication. Internet of Things enlarges the system with data transfer. Here fingerprint recognition system is used to get all previous records of a patient's health. We are providing an interface for live demonstration and suggestion in a dual communicative way.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Framework for Brain Tumor Classification through Histopathological Image
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Further most oncologist varies in their conclusions around the determination utilizing histopathological-pictures, so the manual diagnosis of brain tumour is troublesome, and it too needs elevated involvement. Building a show of brain tumour classification is a fundamental assignment. CAD empowers productive and exact conclusion of this sort of imaging. In addition, it makes a difference early determination of brain tumours. Profound learning has started to advance within the final decades, so convolutional neural systems/networks are utilized to classify brain tumours. We presented the programmed brain tumour classification strategies to assist specialists in examination and treatment, which can naturally classify the histopathological pictures as generous or dangerous. This study’s hypothetical premise is creating a profound learning tumour classification framework. It employs a profound learning approach that is the proposed CNN model comprises of three stages. The primary stage is pre-processing. The moment stage is the highlight extraction organize that takes input as augmented preprocessed pictures. This stage has two divisions. The primary stage comprises of three parallel CNN branches with different filter sizes to extricate distinctive include levels. We blended the three parallel branches within the moment stage, which produced a highlight combination way that diminished the time complexity and upgraded the outlined methods, performance. The third stage classifies the melded highlights as generous or dangerous. The Cancer-Genome-Atlas Glioblastoma Multiform-DB (TCGA-GBM) is utilized &implemented and contains 19,507 files of brain tumour tissue for 237 patients. The data was parted into three sections: 60%, 20%, 20% for training, validation, and testing. A few tests were performed to attain the finest demonstrative precision of 91.37 %. The results are compared to the outcomes about of different methods within the writing. The presented preferences of our method make it offer assistance within the briefest treatment time, particularly within the case of the large-scale histopathological images of the brain tumour dataset where the normal testing time per picture for the proposed strategy was 0.08 seconds.

articleTitle: Ensemble Approach for Credit Card Fraud Detection Using Champion-Challenger Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Credit cards have evolved as a way of transferring money through E-payment systems, as digital payments develop to smoothly help corporate transactions around the world. Credit card fraud, on the other side, has continued to be a huge global danger to financial firms, with various reports and figures revealing the scope of the problem. In this study, we used three distinct ensemble models to implement a champion-challenger framework and evaluated the best model amongst them. With Accuracy, Precision, Recall, and F1-Score of 99.86, 99.73, 99.99, 99.86, Challenger 1, which is an aggregation of Random Forest, Adaboost, and LSTM, was crowned the winner.

articleTitle: Improving Accuracy in Intelligent Coronary Heart Disease Diagnosis Prediction Model using Support Vector Clustering Technique Compared over Random Forest Classifier Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The goal is to improve the accuracy of a novel coronary heart disease prediction model utilizing support vector clustering in contrast to a random forest classifier. Materials and Procedures: Random Forest Classifier and Support Vector Clustering Technique Heart disease is predicted using algorithms. Study contains two groups with sample size 5 for each group. For identification and prediction, a cardiac dataset is employed. The dataset comprises 14 variables that might be utilized to identify whether a patient has heart problems. Results: The results were produced using two classifiers having statistical significance: For accuracy, the sig (2-tailed) p-value observed is 0.002 (p<0.05). In terms of heart disease prediction, the Support Vector Clustering Technique appears to perform significantly better than Random Forest. Conclusion: In the novel coronary heart disease prediction the Support Vector Clustering Technique, with an accuracy of 82.85 percent, Compared to the Random Forest Classifier Algorithm, which has an accuracy of 79.63 percent, it seems to be more accurate.

articleTitle: Heart Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Heart disease has been major reason for demise for many decades. The early detection of heart problems, as well as the regular checkup of doctors, shall reduce the death cases. Anyways, correct detection of cardiac issues in every situation and discussion of a case for 24 hours by a croaker is not possible since it takes additional understanding, time, and expertise. A heart complaint vaticination has been presented in this work to detect upcoming heart complaints using Machine learning techniques. An effective machine learning approach created from a separate examination of multiple machine learning algorithms in Python should be employed for the correct identification of heart disease. The ANN algorithm achieved 90 percent accuracy, the Nave Bayes algorithm achieved 86 percent accuracy, the Random forest algorithm achieved 80 percent accuracy, the KNN algorithm achieved 79.9 percent accuracy, and the Decision Tree system achieved 75 percent accuracy.

articleTitle: Anomaly and activity recognition in a video surveillance using Masked Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Video cameras are used to monitor many of the public locations in today's globe, including supermarkets, public gardens, malls, university campuses, and so on. There is a requirement to provide crucial security and monitor aberrant anomaly activity at such locations. The fundamental disadvantage of the previous method is that manual procedures must be conducted 24 hours a day, seven days a week, and human error is a possibility. The goal of this study is to detect anomalies and recognise human activity in films. The masked spatiotemporal autoencoder (MAE) is used to detect video anomalies. The suggested model design has three basic elements: a spatial encoder, a temporal encoder-decoder, and a spatial decoder.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Detection and Classification Using Clustering and Comparison with FCM
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research analyses the techniques of brain tumour detection with the help of K means clustering and FCM. Moreover, a brief comparison of the FCM technique and K means clustering would also be discussed in this research. In order to increase the accuracy of the comparison, this research would use technical data analysis, where with the help of python programming, the effectiveness of these two methods can be identified. Additionally, with the help of arithmetic calculation and python programming, the research would prove that K means clustering is better than FCM due to its low processing time.

articleTitle: e-Health Assisted Smart Supermarket
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)

authors.preferredName: S. S. P. M. Sharma B

abstract: Worldwide improvement is technology can be noticed at a faster pace in every piece of application and developments. At the same time, the exploitation of technologies in certain sector is very stumpy. Usually people buy various things from the shops without knowing the ingredients present in that. Where some of the ingredients may not be good for the individuals based on their health conditions. The intake of such items creates health issues in various ways and feel later for consuming such items. So far there is no pre-indication system to indicate the purchaser about the health issues for the items purchased from the shop. In this paper, proposed a smart trolley that assists the customer about the health issues related of a product he/she picked to purchase with the support of a mobile app in the smart phone.

articleTitle: Drug Review System Using Machine Learning by Comparing Linear Support Vector Machine with Naïve Bayes Classifier to Measure Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In comparison to Naive Bayes (NB) Classifier, innovative Linear Support Vector Machine (LSVM) is used to forecast enhanced drug review systems for boosting Accuracy. Materials and Methods: In this research, two groups are compared, novel Linear Support Vector Machine (N = 10),Naive Bayes (N = 10) was generated according to total sample size using the g power software by taking into account alpha of 0.05, enrollment ratio of 0.1, 95% confidence interval, and power of 80%. Result: The accuracy rate of Linear Support Vector Machine (SVM) is 97.75 % whereas results of (NB) accuracy rate are 89.34%. There is a significant difference in accuracy rate (P = 0.045) with pre-test power of 80 % in SPSS Statistical analysis. Conclusion: The Linear Support Vector Machine (SVM) performs significantly better in terms of accuracy for predicting the enhanced drug review system when compared to the (NB) Classifier.

articleTitle: Efficient Integrity Checking and Secured Data Sharing in Cloud
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: "It is to protect data in a cloud server from third-party access". Most present systems suffer from a complex key managing issue since they depends on expensive public key infrastructure (PKI),it may make RDIC implementation challenging in practice. Remote data integrity checking (RDIC) in the proposed system allows a data storage server used to approve and a verifier which is accurately storing the data of the owner. Here we introduce a new identity-based RDIC protocol that uses key which is the same form of cryptographic primitives which are introduced to reduce the system performance, complex and expense of initiating and oversee public key authentication substructure which is in PKI-based Remote data integrity checking (RDIC) methods. The Identity based RDIC that is replica of hostage, which includes safety, are formalized opposed to a rogue cloud server, as well as providing a zero-knowledge required privacy from an identified third-party verifier.

articleTitle: Using Machine Learning Techniques for Cancer Classification
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Given the extremely high death and suffering rates caused by breast cancer, women are particularly at risk. Because of this, it is imperative that algorithms be developed to find breast disease's early warning signs. Decision trees, random forests, regression analysis, and Mri are four categorised algorithms that detect cancer, and the end results were contrasted. Machine learning is essential for predicting breast cancer's early signs. Three data augmentation different classifiers will be used in this research. when categorising algorithms Data with unbalanced classifications are a serious issue that calls for careful treatment and preprocessing. We'll train the various M.L. models using a large dataset of breast cancer patients. The optimal method for this issue is ultimately determined by comparing all the strategies in terms of efficiency and precision. Our research will demonstrate the efficacy of several methods for this category of breast cancer so that we can use the proper strategy.

articleTitle: Multivariate Classification of Dry Beans using Pipelined Dimensionality Reduction Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Machine learning methods have been employed frequently in the agricultural sector for crops analysis. These artificial intelligence-based models facilitate the understanding about crop sub species, their diseases and other significant issues concerning their yield. It helps in classification of several species of similar crops and also to identify specific sub-species among several others. The machine learning models can also be utilized to classify different types of beans, grains and pulses. It greatly assists in the evaluation of high-quality grains and their uniformity in size. Many features define each variety of the beans but not all the features equally contribute in the process of classification. In this paper, a Pipelined Linear Discriminant Analysis methodology has been used to remove insignificant features and estimators were applied for classification. Seven machine learning models were investigated and the overall prediction accuracy was 92%. Support Vector Machine, Random Forest and Multilayer Perceptron had higher accuracy of 93%. This methodology also efficiently overcomes the problem of overfitting and at the same time increases the overall performance of the models. We further investigate the impact of dimensionality reduction on the dataset.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Sign Language Recognition Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The process by which two or more people exchange their information, views, and opinions on different situations and on different topics is known as communication. The need for a common platform for humans to communicate with one another has played an essential role in the evolution of human civilization ever since its start. Human beings communicate with each other using several verbal and non-verbal cues. Non-verbal communication involves the use of signs and hand gestures. Hard-of-hearing individuals can communicate only using non-verbal cues and they rely on others to communicate with them using hand gestures as well. Systematic sign language systems, for instance, the American Sign Language, the Indian Sign Language and several such similar sign language systems have been developed to aid the specially abled individuals. Sign Language recognition (SLR) is a process that uses technology to recognize what the specially-abled person is saying by identifying the signs and hand gestures and returning the output in the form of text or speech. In this survey, a comparative analysis is done based on the various techniques and algorithms used and implemented to carry out the process of Sign language Recognition (SLR).

articleTitle: Real Time Automation of Agriculture Environment for Indian Agricultural System using IoT
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Indian irrigation covers just a third of the nation's total land area; the country ranks second in global irrigated areas. Rains are inconsistent and there is a lack of water. Most of the regions need canals to be constructed for irrigation that does not rely on rainfall. When it comes to irrigation, efficient water use is critical for the process. Intelligent irrigation is where most farmers begin their transition to IoT agriculture. Optimizing the water schedule and amount may save water, money, and yield the best produce on the field. Farm irrigation systems get soil moisture and temperature data from sensors using sensor-based IoT technology. In response to these indications, a platform activates drip irrigation when there is insufficient moisture in the soil. While watering plants, our article aims to reduce water use by using a more efficient method.The proposed system makes use of sensors such as soil moisture sensors and temperature sensors. To communicate with Blynk, data is sent via the microcontroller. Blynk is used to monitor the data, while the cloud is utilised to store it. Using this technology, watering may be automated and monitored at the same time.

articleTitle: IOT based Electric Vehicles - Implementation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In today's world, autonomous automation is inspiring researchers, and growing human needs are driving students and scientists to build new automation devices. This paper will help you understand the changing trends in self-driving car technology. Advances and upgrades in technology have improved their performance and usage. The most important requirement for an automated device or vehicle is the Communication between them. In addition, the Government of India attaches great importance to military progress. In this regard, this paper focuses on a perfect connection system between remote controlled bots, as long as the connection is not an obstacle. To achieve this goal, the relay device (with Raspberry Pi) is configured as a repeater of the connection network that connects the remote control to the vehicle (bot). In this project, the Wi-Fi adapter will act as a beacon or extender to extend the connectivity and range of remote vehicles. This connection allows the bot to easily capture live feeds and send data for face recognition on the receiving side. This project leverages advanced research on network configurations and intercommunication schemes for IoT devices. The range of remote connections is Extended by the relay chain method. This further improves the connection with the bot through subsequent relay bots, making data transmissions untraceable and encrypted. By using existing algorithms, obstacles and Suspicious activity can be easily detected and sent to military bases.

articleTitle: Improved Localization Algorithm Using Hybrid Firefly Genetic Algorithm in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research work analysed the hybrid approach of Hybrid Genetic Algorithm -Firefly localization algorithm. The control variables, total number of sensor nodes, position known anchor nodes or landmark nodes, and the Genetic Algorithm-firefly localization problem are used to refine the Genetic Algorithm -firefly localization problem. The full number of iterations is taken into account, as well as the solution space. The distance between the sensor node and the anchor nodes is measured, and then the sensor node's location is estimated. Encoding, describe fitness feature, range, crossover, mutation, fitness function, beauty, distance, action, and stopping criteria are all part of the Hybrid Genetic Algorithm -Firefly localization algorithm implementation procedure are explained detailed. As the results it is demonstrated that the Hybrid Genetic Algorithm-Firefly Localization Algorithm iterated for 100 iterations has sensor node position knowledge estimation accuracy of 100% for firefly population vectors of 15, 18, and 20 with better time complexity.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis for Cloud-Based Olap over Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: OLAP-based middleware for parallel OLAP query processing is presented in this study, which builds on previous research results to provide two new areas of authority application built on top of OLAP. This multi-faceted investigation of several business viewpoints is referred to as "online analytical processing" (OLAP).The fundamental purpose of OLAP systems is to allow users to conduct manual interpretation and analysis of corporate summary and extensive statistics. It's critical to realise that OLAP require users to know what data they are looking for OLAP merely analyses past facts, whereas "data-mining techniques" allow organisations to make predictions about future events. Clustering, identifying, and predictive analysis approaches are the three types of data-mining approaches. This research has considered secondary data collection method to gather informative and relevant "cloud based OLAP over big data" related information from different secondary sources such as journals, articles.

articleTitle: Smart Device for Effective Communication in the Healthcare System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The study examines deep learning (ML), a kind of artificial neural system (AI) that enables software developers to start improving prediction before they have completed training. Given the value of data, creating intelligent methods for controlling the already pervasive content systems is a crucial first step to fully independent agents. A number of businesses, including medical diagnosis, discussion of results and processing, science and research, and others, have benefited from machine learning. Patients may freely move about while their pulses are continuously monitored thanks to a number of small IoT devices for vital sign sensors that are already on the market. Although it is still challenging to guarantee very exact findings, the majority of contemporary equipment are capable of achieving up to 94 percent accuracy.It may be challenging to measure glucose concentration and cardiac rhythms, particularly for individuals who are addressed at medical institutions. Intermittent heart rate monitoring is insufficient to guard against sudden changes for vital signs, and conventional hospital cardiac rhythm monitoring methods include tethering patients to wired equipment all the time, restricting their mobility.

articleTitle: Early detection of DDoS attack using integrated SDN-Blockchain architecture for IoT
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The advancement in technology with the internet commences the new era of communication by allowing people to communicate through text, audio and video calling, images and video clips and various other applications. The applications of internet paved the way to a technology called Internet of Things (IoT). IoT is interpreted as communication between components, (e.g., sensors and actuators) through the internet designed for application-oriented assistance. IoT is simple and user friendly which attracted the people to adapt the technology. Despite the immense benefits of the IoT device, it is vulnerable.This results in the devices to undergo various attacks. Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attack challenges the security in IoT devices. Therefore, this paper proposes the integrated SDN-Blockchain architecture to provide the secure connection for IoT devices. Software Defined Networking (SDN) technology is used in optimizing the network management, enabling a dynamic and efficient network configuration programming thereby optimizing the performance and monitoring the network. SDN transforms computer network by segregating control plane and data plane. Blockchain is represented as collection of blocks which are linked together as a back traced list.The previous block hash is used to connect the blocks together in the chain. The characteristics of Blockchain include decentralization, peer-to-peer connectivity, and immutable ledgers.

articleTitle: Harmonic Distortion reduction in Power System to improve Reliability and power quality
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Power quality issues are caused by the extensive usage of power electronics equipment like rectifiers, inverters, etc. in power systems. One such issue is the the generation of voltage and current overtones that cause equipment heating, demand waveform deformation, overvoltage, dips, and other problems. Additionally, non-linear loads like speed controllers and SMPS exist, and UPS harmonic current production in the power system is caused by etc. They consume reactive energy components of AC mains current, therefore disrupting the supply current waveform. We must thus correct for the harmonic component in order to prevent the effects of harmonics. Shunt Active Power Filters are one of the most efficient ways to eliminate harmonics in a power system, among other methods (SAPF). In order to demonstrate why one technique is superior than another, this paper provides a detailed performance study of SAPF there under dual current management techniques, synchronous frame comparison theory and immediate current and voltage theory (p-q) (d-q). Both methods create a reference current for the filter that balances the power system's reactive power or harmonic current component. The harmonic current controller, which is utilised to provide the IGBT rectifier a corrective gating operation, so aids in the removal of harmonic components, is detailed in this study.

articleTitle: Stock Price Prediction using Deep Learning and FLASK
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The forecasting of stock prices is one of the most explored issues, and it attracts the attention of both academics and business professionals. It is quite difficult to make predictions about the stock market, and it takes extensive research into the patterns of data. With the expansion of the internet and indeed the growth of social media, online media and opinions frequently mirror investor sentiment. The volatility and non-linear structure of the financial stock markets makes accurate forecasting difficult. One of the sophisticated analysis techniques that is being used by academics in a variety of fields is the neural network. In this paper, we proposed deep learning techniques for google stock price prediction. A dataset from Kaggle was collected and applied deep learning techniques RNN, LSTM variants. We achieved better results with Bidirectional LSTM. We also created a web app for stock prediction using Christ University python FLASK.

articleTitle: KNN Based Peak-LOF for Outlier Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Data mining is a concept of getting relevant data from massive databases. Nowadays, there is a lack of Prediction of disease is increased predominantly. Hence, we need to remove the inaccurate data that has been spread over in the dataset, which leads to inaccurately predicting disease. Outliers are more prone to prediction mechanisms. This paper includes the detection of outliers in disease prediction mechanisms. The goal of this paper is to bring out exact data instead of getting invalid data by finding outliers and handling them with care. Outliers can be detected using a KNN based peak-LOF based approach with manhattan distance metrics. In this paper, a proper study on outlier detection mechanisms has been done.

articleTitle: An Efficient Reliable Federated Learning Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Many organizations in this competitive world use data analysis to provide useful insights for decision making and problem solving tasks that exist in real - time scenarios. To preserve the information provided, technological improvements are needed to handle data privacy in the system. In real-world circumstances, large amounts of data will be collected from a variety of sources and need to be analyzed and protected from unauthorized access. As a result, machine learning models must be deployed across all sites without the need to upload data, as this could compromise privacy. Federated learning helps to provide this privacy for the data. In this paper, we have analyzed two methods of building machine learning models - the centralized or conventional method of building machine learning models and the federated approach of building models. The performance metrics in terms of accuracy has been examined. The results are used to highlight the improved accuracy of federated approach compared to the centralized approach without compromising the privacy of the data.

articleTitle: Formation of Text from Indian Sign Language using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Approximately 5% of people around the world suffer from a "disabling" hearing loss that will require rehabilitation. Around 2.42 million Deaf and Mute (D&M) individuals live in India, the world's second most populous country. In modern-day society, people do not think of these impairments as disabilities; it is merely perceived as a lifestyle choice. In reality, life is a lot harder for them as D&M individuals cannot communicate verbally, having to resort to mediums such as using visual media and finger spelling to communicate. However, the vast majority of non-D&M people are unaware of sign language, resulting in an extensive communication gap. This paper addresses this very issue by proposing a ML model that recognizes the Indian Sign Language (ISL) using Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for sign language recognition and a Graphical User Interface (GUI) that captures these hand gestures and translates them into text. An ISL dataset with 31,945 images was used, and using the proposed approach an accuracy of 98.82% was achieved with the CNN model. This serves as the backend for a GUI which converts ISL to text.

articleTitle: Deep Convolution Neural Network for RBC Images
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The suggested study’s objectives are to develop an unique criterion-based method for classifying RBC pictures and to increase classification accuracy by utilizing Deep Convolutional Neural Networks instead of Conventional CNN Algorithm. Materials and Procedures A dataset-master image dataset of 790 pictures is used to apply Deep Convolutional Neural Network. Convolutional Neural Network and Deep Convolutional Neural Network comparison using deep learning has been suggested and developed to improve classification accuracy of RBC pictures. Using Gpower, the sample size was calculated to be 27 for each group. Results: When compared to Convolutional Neural Network, Deep Convolutional Neural Network had the highest accuracy in classifying blood cell pictures (95.2%) and the lowest mean error (85.8 percent). Between the classifiers, there is a statistically significant difference of p=0.005. The study demonstrates that Deep Convolutional Neural Networks perform more accurately than Conventional Neural Networks while classifying photos of blood cells[1].

articleTitle: An Efficient Neural Network Model for Sentiment Analysis using Bi-LSTM and CNN
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: These days, internet users are extremely keen in expressing their thoughts on a variety of goods or products in social networking sites, which has led to an increase in the amount of human generated content found on the web. Analysis of user sentiment on social media platforms like Twitter has emerged as a highly essential and difficult job in recent years. A nontraditional technique is required in order to complete the job of sentiment analysis in such a scenario due to the features of the data being used. In addition, analysis of sentiment on social media platforms is a basic topic that has a wide range of fascinating applications. The majority of the currently available algorithms for classifying sentiment on social media determine the polarity of sentiment solely based on the textual content of posts and ignore additional information available mainly on the following platforms. This In this work recommends an architecture for combining CNN and Bi-LSTM models into one another. The implementation of BILCNN which is a combined approach includes a word embedding concept that transforms tweets into numerical form, a CNN layer that accepts attribute embedding as source and generates features with a smaller criterion, and a Bi-LSTM model that takes input again from CNN layer and generates classification results. GloVe and Word2Vec were both used in their own right in order to determine the effect that the word embedding response had on the model that was suggested. The datasets for Yelp and Tweets were obtained, and BILCNN was applied to them. The findings suggest that the suggested system is capable of providing suggestions by a precision of 94.8 percent, offering consumers a satisfactory performance in their recommendations.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Virtual Lab Environment for Embedded System and IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In recent years, the education officials have been forced to cancel classes and close the doors of the campus across the world in response to the growth of coronavirus outbreak. Due to the development of e-learning, a significant transformation is happening in education. Digital platforms are used in e-learning for giving instructions remotely. The faculty chose to take video conference classes using one platform and the resources are uploaded in another platform which are accessed by students. But while coming to laboratory classes, the hands-on experience of students on the equipment and components are totally missed. Resources are in the colleges and students are at home. This separation creates a long gap in the education. At KPR Institution of Engineering and Technology (KPRIET), a virtual lab setup with controllers and essential hardware modules was implemented in the Internet of Things (IoT) laboratory of Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) Department, where students can access and control it from their current location using secured login credentials.Virtual setup provides an easy access for the students to get hands-on experience with the academic laboratory sessions. These sessions are very useful for the students to gain more relevant and keen knowledge of their laboratories. This project provides a greater number of students to engage with their academic theory and practical laboratory sessions. We use server software and addons along with Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) as well as Virtual Network Computing (VNC).

articleTitle: Human Sign Language Recognition Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Disability of deaf and dumb is one of the major significant problems in the human world. The development of technologies for recognition of deaf and dumb impaired peoples is done by several methodologies. One of the most significant components in helping sign language users to communicate with the rest of society is recognizing sign language. Machine learning and image categorization can help computers in recognizing sign language, which can subsequently be deciphered by others. In this paper, convolutional neural networks were used to recognize sign language motions by recognizing the symbolic hand gestures of deaf and dumb impaired peoples. Deaf and dumb persons acquire sign language, which is largely unknown to normal people. This makes it challenging for regular people to communicate with disabled people who are deaf and dumb. The main focus of our paper is to make predictions of hand gestures from deaf and dumb peoples. Our paper recognizes different types of hand gestures as input and make predictions with accuracy level based on pre-trained dataset models by using Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) Algorithm.

articleTitle: Biometric Electronic Voting Machine Using Fingerprint Sensor and Arduino
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Election is essential and unavoidable part of democratic country and also it is a right of each and every person in the country. Everyone is responsible for secure and valid vote during the election. Government plays a major role during the election to achieve a successful election. Electronic voting machine is currently employed during election also it is possible to do misuse and man power is required to verify the details of the voter. This paper overcomes the cons of the existing method using biometric verification. This system ensures more secure, reliable and less manpower than the existing method.
