articleTitle: Design of Coplanar Wave Guide Triple-band Bandpass Filter for Minimising the Return loss on X-band Application in Comparison with the Microstrip Triple Bandpass Filter
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Aim: To design a compact Innovative Coplanar Waveguide (CPW) triple band Bandpass Filter (TBPF) for low band (8 – 12 GHz) and compared with Microstrip Triple Bandpass Filter (MTBP). Materials and Methods: The proposed design is based on the CPW triple-band bandpass filter, which consists of a simple rectangular frame constructed on a 1.6mm thick commercially available Silicon material substrate. Group 1 contained a microstrip dual-bandpass filter and group 2 was the CPW dual-band pass filter. Total sample size calculated is 20 for each group 10 with G power 80%. Results: The simulated and experimental results for triple-bandpass filter Return Loss is increased to -17.40 dB, -13.06 dB, -19.48 dB at 8.80 GHz, 10.5 GHz, 11 GHz. The obtained value of significance is 0.028 (p < 0.05). The triple-band pass filter was designed and its performance was evaluated using ansoft HFSS version 15.0 software. Conclusion: The results of simulation shows that the insertion loss of a triple band pass filter has significantly increased for the CPW triple-band bandpass filter.

articleTitle: An Efficient Deep Learning Approach for Plant Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: During the stages in which plants are growing, they are more likely to be infected by a variety of diseases. Because of insufficient laboratory facilities and a dependance on the knowledge of specialists, initial plant disease identification is a time-consuming process. If the diseases are not discovered in their early stages, then it is possible that they will have a negative impact on the overall yield, which will lead to a reduction in the profits made by the farmers. Several studies have discussed various state-of-the-art systems that are based on Deep Learning as well as Machine Learning methodologies in an effort to find a solution to this issue. On the other hand, the majority of such systems either employ large numbers of input variables or even have poor accuracy in their classifications. In this paper, an innovative combined approach for automatic detection of plant diseases is proposed. The model is based on Variational Autoencoder (VAE) networks and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). Techniques for the automated detection of plant diseases offer a number of benefits, including the simplification of the lengthy process of observing large agricultural farms and the identification of disease symptoms at an early stage. In this work, the proposed combined approach is utilized to detect the disease known as Bacterial Spot that is present in plants by utilizing the leaf images of those plants. The proposed method achieves an accuracy rate of 98.85 percent when used for testing and 99.17 percent when used for training.

articleTitle: Improving Performance Analysis in Classification with Accuracy of Adult Income Salary using Novel Gated Residual Neural Network in Comparison with Logistic Regression Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Aim: Prediction of adult income by getting accuracy using Novel Gated Residual Neural Network (NGRNN) as the difference from Logistic Regression. Materials and Methods: Accuracy is performed with employee data as adults with samples of 32561 samples. Classification of adult income is performed by the novel gated residual network with a total number which is measured as samples (N=94) and logistic regression algorithm with a total number which is measured as samples (N=94), the proposed algorithm novel gated residual neural network (NGRNN) implies salary prediction that can be compared with Logistic Regression algorithm which is the second technique. Results: Novel Gated residual neural network (NGRNN) from the dataset Adult, produces an accuracy of 95% which can be comparatively higher than Logistic Regression accuracy of 74%. A significance T-test calculation based on statistics values as 0.006 from the Independent input sample. It shows that the p-value is around 0.05. Conclusion: Prediction accuracy of NGRNN techniques shows better when compared to existing techniques in income prediction. Novel Gated Residual Neural Networks have accuracy higher compared with Logistic Regression.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis Using Novel Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Before purchasing a product or service, People typically analyse the information about the product such as cost, warranty, quality etc. Only after getting satisfaction about such things, People try to buy that product based on the quality of service received. Since this process takes time and a chance of being duped by the dealer are higher, Sentiment analysis (SA) is necessary to purchase a product without any hesitation. Sentiment analysis examines reviews and comments of the products, which are in the form of text that requires several processes for providing the desirable information to the People. Moreover, Furthermore, SA is an important Natural Language Processing (NLP) research direction. In this paper, a novel sentiment analysis model is developed based on the Machine Learning (ML) Algorithm, which provides an accurate sentiment information for the texts having different perspectives. The method of Stop words are used for data pre-processing. By using count vectorizer, the text data is converted into the form of vectors for extracting the desired features. Finally, the type of sentiment whether it is positive, negative or neutral is determined based on the ML classifier namely, Random Forest (RF) classifier. This model is developed using novel ML approach that provides an accurate sentiment classification to the people or the industries who need the sentiment analysis.

articleTitle: Designing Hybrid Optimized Bidirectional based Controller (HOBC) with DC-DC Boost Converter for Power system
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Hybrid Energy Storage System (HESS) is formed by combining the ESD and the benefits of various ESDs are utilized. In the microgrid, every storage device’s highest operation is ensured by algorithms of efficient control, which is essential for sharing power among numerous ESDs and also ESD’s power output is decided by Conventional Fuzzy Logic Controllers (FLCs) with the consideration of fuzzy controlled ESD’s State of Charge (SoC) and entire demand of power. Futhermore, in photovoltaic (PV) generating system, efficiency of output and quality of electrical energy is improved by the method of Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT). Because of the PV system’s characteristics of time-varying output and its non-linearity, accomplishing MPPT is extremely difficult. Modified Firefly Algorithm (MF) is assisted for the utilization of Hybrid Optimized Bidirectional based Controller (HOBC). This predictive structure’s control parameters are optimized by using Adaptive Neuro Fuzzy Interference System (ANFIS). The rate of faster conversion is achieved by standard algorithm’s position formula and it is modified by this proposed algorithm. Perturbation and Observation Algorithm (P&O) and Adaptive Fuzzy Logic Controller (AFLC) are the two state-of-art method compared with various parameters in this simulation.

articleTitle: Enhancement of the Switched Reluctance Motor Using Predictive Current Control
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This paper proposes that the switched reluctance motor is the best alternative compared to the permanent magnet DC motor currently used in EV’s. As the permanent magnet present in the DC motor, it producing heat, which reduces the efficiency. To overcome it, we use a switched reluctance motor. Even though it is the better alternative for a permanent magnet DC motor, it also suffers from serious disadvantages, such as Torque ripple at high- speed operation; due to this, the stability of the motor is decreased. In order to reduce the torque ripple and improve output power, we use predictive current control. This predictive current control reduces the torque ripple and increases the stability of the system. SRM was controlled by predictive current control. In this predictive current control method, the motor current is tracked along with the reference, with torque, voltage, speed is predicted. It determines at which the controlling parameters the predicted value get more efficiency and achieves the minimum torque ripple, improves the performance of the machine due to its controlled voltage.

articleTitle: An Ensemble Auto-Encoder for Age Estimation Based on Human Facial Expressions
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The age estimation from facial expression is most rapid topic of interest, these days because of its great applications. It is a challenging task because of huge intra-class facial expression differences due to age. In this study, a methodology has been proposed to estimate the age depending upon the expressions of face of a human. The proposed methodology initiates its process with clarification of facial expression which is followed by the clustering process. The images of the database are clustered based on expressions. For this purpose, six facial expressions (Happiness, Disgust, Anger, Fear, surprise and sadness) are considered in this study. For getting better accuracy in age estimation, the features are extracted cluster wise using Binarized Statistical image feature (BSIF) in multi-layer fashion. The final feature vector is feed to ensemble auto-encoder (EAE) to train and estimate age by considering min Error value. The age categories considered are four: child (0-10), young (11-30), Middle (31-50) and senior citizen (50+). To estimate age, this study considered two databases namely: MORPH-II, PAL. The test results on the chosen databases perform better in terms of estimation of age when contrasted with other methods of the state of art.

articleTitle: Controlling the Temperature of superheated steam of Boiler in Thermal Power Station by using Micro controller based closed loop control system
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In the secure and financial process of power plant, the capacity and control of chief steam temperature can play a significant role since the major thermal power unit’s parameter. However, superheated steam temperature (SST)’s control has become more and more demanding issue as unidentified instability happened through recurrent and widespread modifications and severe control necessities for the effectiveness and protection. As the irregular renewable diffusion has been developing, this can be still cruel. Therefore, the structure of principle and parameter setting technique of the novel foundation controller (NFC) is presented in this paper for steam temperature control system improvement in thermal power station using inertial combination filter (ICF) and micro controller-based closed loop control system, in which the temperature decreasing water flow control will be done. Finally, the proposed system is simulated with the help of MATLAB.

articleTitle: Effective Child Safety System Based on RFID and Face Recognition Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: A safety system is necessary for the parents to take care of their infants in their work time too. This purpose caused the approach of the child care centers. Though they sense insecurity in those kinds of centers, the parents have no different way to proceed. So, we came up with a system to make certain the protection of the kids inside the toddler care centers or preschools. This system guarantees the children's safety with the help of a clever wearable card with the assistance of the Internet of things sensor network. It also offers a way to track the youngster within the school or child care areas. This wearable card design allows it to be handy and calls for little technological knowledge from the consumer. This device's goal is to assist parents track the youngster and ensure their safety even as they're under the control of the faculties or baby caretakers. This gadget works through the usage of sensor nodes to reveal the environment and handing over concurrent records to the database that was connected to the server within the cloud. An internet-based interface permits customers to get the data saved at the server. The system may also transmit emergency notifications to the person through a software application developed whenever an unauthorized person comes to pick up the child from these centers. Its cause is to allow verbal exchange among the parent or caretaker and the kid by way of knowing their real-time location. The kid's position has been traced with the usage of RFID in real-time. We reviewed relevant literature and tested the strategies used to reap similar but wonderful consequences.

articleTitle: Analysis of Broadcast Reliability for Data Center Inter connect
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This paper focuses on the two distinct categories of network reliability analysis for the 2D torus OIN: time un-constrained and time constrained broadcast reliability. Both theaforementioned reliabilities are analyzed for different networksizes extended from 8 nodes in every dimension to extended upto64 in each dimension. The size of the network is scaled by a multiple of 4 in each dimension. The analysis of broadcast reliability includes analysis, evaluation, and comparison along with the implementation of two different routing algorithms namely XYrouting algorithm (XYRA) and binary optical routing algorithm (BORA). Both there liabilities are analysed in Matlab. For time constrained reliability the rate of node failure is (10−6/hr)while in unconstrained analysis analysed at numerous confidence interval of node relaibility.

articleTitle: State-Space representation of D-Q Controlled Grid Integrated Photovoltaic at Utility level
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Electrical grid stability is a major concern with large-scale solar integration. The dynamics of a solar photovoltaic system can be triggered with variation in solar irradiance. Existing PV generator models in which the dynamics are included utilize implicit equations that insist on specific software and iterative solution algorithm. A state space representation model is used to reduce computational difficulty. Lambert W-function is in-cooperated to enumerate solar PV generators equation in explicit form. Here a dynamic controlled two-stage PV model is grid interconnected through a 3-phase inverter (voltage source). The inverter is to stay connected under any disturbance to the grid. This paper proposes a modified dq scheme with synchronous reference frame to control the inverter connecting the solar photovoltaic (SPV) system and the grid. Dual closed-loop control is used to connect dynamic controlled two-stage PV model to the grid using grid- connected (3-phase) VSI. The MATLAB/SIMULINK environment is used to perform the study.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Automated System for Porter Services in India

articleTitle: PLC based ATS Working with Load Sensing of Power Generator

abstract: This article proposes and analysis the system which is used for automatic source switching and monitoring. An automatic transfer switch (ATS) for a 1 ø power source has been intended to empower the programmed activity and transmission of the supply between a public effectiveness of supply and a power generator. articleTitle: Effective Detection of Exomphalos in Fetal Ultrasound Images Using Canny edge detector
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The detection of Exomphalos, a type of abdominal wall defect which consents the abdominal contents to obtrude outside as like sac structure using DSS-Decision Support System is proposed. Types of Exomphalos are major and minor exomphalos. In Exomphalos Major, the liver, intestines and occasionally other organs are confined in a sac whereas in Exomphalos Minor, the intestine alone rests in the sac. This proposed Computer aided decision support system takes mid-trimester ultrasound images of the abdominal wall of the fetus as input and processes the images using efficient algorithms at every phase to detect Exomphalos and further classify it. It aims at eradicating manual intervention and to accurate the diagnosis. This system has four stages: Pre-processing mid-trimester ultrasound images, Segmentation for region of interest, Feature Extraction and Feature Selection from the region of interest. In this paper, various filters and several edge detection algorithms are used for De-speckling and segmentation respectively. After the acquisition of results, their performances are compared and it has been foundthat Median filter is effectual for despeckling and Canny edge detection technique is efficient for segmentation.

articleTitle: Prediction of Diabetes at early stages using ANN & Outlier Exposure
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In the present scenario of medical field, Diabetes is a critical issue which do require a lot of attention and if predicted in early stages it can be cured easily. From past few decades many machine learning algorithms are being used for detection at early stages. In this research our principal attention is on prediction of diabetes for pregnant woman that can also be termed as Gestational Diabetes. This may also lead to affecting of Type 2 Diabetes. Several researchers worked hard to predict the results accurately. ANN has considerable edge over other classification algorithms. Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Data Analytics, and other latest domains are being engaged in prediction of several categories of diseases in the health sector. ANNs (Artificial Neural Network) made a massive impact in medical department further egresses for various data driven applications in domain of health care. It starts with disease diagnosis, image processing of infected organs and finally predicting the disease accurately. Our primary focus is finding out the effect of parameters over dataset to forecast if a specific person is suffering from diabetes or not. PIMA dataset has been considered with 20 neurons for hidden layers and acquired accuracy of 86.2% when there are no outliers in dataset. This research depicts the accuracy & effectiveness of ANN model when compared to other classification algorithms.

articleTitle: Know Your Customer (KYC) as a service for Business Process Management (BPM) using Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Business Process Management (BPM) is used in this article to explain the implementation of a know your customer process in the cloud servers.This assists in the identification of individuals working in banking and financial institutions, as well as the effective monitoring of unusual activity and transactions. Customer comprehensive research refers to the efforts that financial institutions and other regulated companies must undertake in order to identify their clients and get key information relevant to conducting business with them, as well as the banking rules that controls such operations.When applied to the organization, business process management (BPM) makes it possible to automate and manage end-to-end business operations by bringing all of the components of the process together into a more efficient whole, including people, resources, and tools. Numerous financial institutions can benefit from cloud computing by gaining access to a centralised service model that is made available through Software as a service(SaaS), Platform as a service(PaaS), and Infrastructure as a service(IaaS) services. Customer know-how was proved to be faster than human know-how during the execution of a plan of this complexity when compared to human know-how.

articleTitle: Emotional Detection Based on Bio Information and Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The ability to recognise emotions is crucial in the healthcare industry. Effective sentiment analysis analysis aids in analysing a variety of factors, including psychosocial health, illness progress, and also more. Healthcare practitioners must also be able to recognise emotions . Emotion recognition monitoring often uses a variety of technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), multimedia systems, pattern classification, digital logic, audiovisual evaluation, etc. The most sequences for inner detection is examined in the present research. In this research, 53 individuals from various UK health services participated in a poll data methods. According to the statistics, the best technology for automatically detecting emotions are ECG and electroencephalogram (EEG)-based integrative systems and pattern matching. The investigation demonstrates that affective recognition is crucial for healthcare practitioners, and that by examining clients' cognitive processes, it may increase the likelihood that they will recuperate.[1].

articleTitle: e-seller Web Application for Vegetables using STS Framework

articleTitle: A Complete Framework for the Smart City through Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Smart city is a name that is emerging nowadays. This particular concept has attracted researchers to this field of study over the past few years. Small grids are key points in making a smart city. However, if new technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI) to provide uninterrupted services and overcome existing challenges. articleTitle: Spotting Web Attack in Iot Networks Using Ensemble Deep Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)

articleTitle: Mobile Edge Computing 5G with Distributed Blockchain Multi-Domain Collaborative in IoT Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The use of mobile edge computing is becoming more and more widespread by the day. It offers the advantages of various things including reach and other things that are not just convenient for the people but also profitable for the companies that act as providers to the people. This is one of the new generations of technology and has various other industries involved in it than just telecommunications and Internet providers. articleTitle: Intelligent Face Mask and Body Temperature Detection System using Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Face mask and body temperature detection is necessary for current pandemic period. Detecting face mask and body temperature helps in decreasing or to avoid spreading of COVID cases especially in crowded areas. The main purpose of face mask recognition and temperature prediction system is to find whether a person is wearing a mask or not and to check the body temperature. With the help of deep neural network based Convolution Neural Network algorithm, face mask has been recognized. For body temperature, LM35 temperature sensor is used. This system undergoes data pre-processing, training, detecting face mask and temperature. By using MobileNet V2, Frontcascadexml file, tensor flow and keras software library the face mask is detected. Then, the result is send to the Arduino microcontroller and displays that the face mask is detected or not by using LED. If the mask is not weared by the person, buzzer will be alarmed. Similar procedure was carried out for monitoring the temperature of a person using LM35 temperature sensor. The main advantages of MobileNet V2 are higher performance, lesser network size and minimum number of parameter are required.

articleTitle: A Smart Homes through Natural Language Processing using Internet of Things

articleTitle: Colorization of Black & White Videos & Photographs
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: When a gray image is given as an input, this paper is an offensive problem guessing the audio version of the image. This problem is under the ban, so the previous methods have worked. articleTitle: Synchronization of Diesel Generator using Micro-Controller
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Development of the world is engaged with the power. One of the main resources of power generation is a diesel generator which uses the non-renewable resource diesel. This paper will explain how to save diesel and increase the lifetime of generators by synchronizing the generator. Synchronization is a technique of parallel operation of generators based on the load. According to load, the microcontroller will power-on that many required generators without any manual intervention. The generators will be started based on the least run time by the micro-controller. After a predefined cool time, the micro-controller will again check for the least run time DGs and it selects the least run time DG for powering on. By this, we can increase the durability of the generator and the main aspect is we can save diesel for our future generations.

articleTitle: An Efficient Method for Secured Data Communication using Chaos Encryption Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: To prevent the information theft from attackers there is a need of mechanism to secure the data. In order to successfully deal with image information theft, it must look for a improved encryption algorithm. articleTitle: Energy Efficient Street Light Controlling System on Detecting Vehicle Movement using Arduino Microcontroller in Comparison with 8051 Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The major aim of the research is an energy efficient street light controlling system on detecting vehicle movement using an arduino microcontroller in comparison with 8051 microcontroller based systems. Materials and Methods: There are two sample groups: an arduino microcontroller and an 8051 microcontroller with 20 samples. The sample size is calculated using G power with pre-test power of 80 % and the alpha value is 0.05 (error rate). Results: From the research, the arduino microcontroller has 95.88 % of energy efficiency, whereas the energy efficiency of a 8051 microcontroller is only 81.42 %. The novel vehicle movement detection outperforms the traditional street light control system. There is a statistical difference in the novel vehicle movement detection and traditional street light signal systems (p < 0.05). The significance value is 0.001. Conclusion: A novel vehicle movement detection using an arduino microcontroller performs significantly better than a 8051 microcontroller based systems.

articleTitle: Exploring Exoplanets using kNN, Logistic Regression and Decision Trees
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: When compared to the vastness of space, our Solar System is of microscopic size. Millions of astrophysical objects exist outside of our Solar System and are being studied. Out of all those objects, studying Exoplanets is of utmost importance. An Exoplanet is a planet that exists out of our Solar System, which means they don’t revolve around our Sun. But it is not always easy to identify whether a given astrophysical object is an Exoplanet. Planets don’t emit light of their own, but the stars they orbit do. When these stars are observed for very long periods of time, we notice a periodic fluctuation of light intensity, also known as the flux of the star. This may be evidence that there may be Exoplanets orbiting the star. Exoplanet identification and confirmation is a task that is usually carried out exclusively by teams of astronomers and astrophysicists who have extensive education and training in their field. NASA’s Kepler Mission has revolutionized the field of Exoplanet Exploration and has enabled researchers to study extrasolar objects of interest. The data harnessed by these satellites are readily available for any individual to use. In our study we use several machine learning algorithms to analyse these data sets and train a model capable of accurately predicting whether an astrophysical body is an Exoplanet or not. The goal of our study is to compare the efficiencies of various machine learning algorithms with respect to detecting an exoplanet.

articleTitle: Harmonic Comparison of 10 Bus Loop and Radial Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In the present scenario, people are migrating towards innovations and technological advancements. Because of this thirst for technological development and innovations, they are fond of innovating automated systems for industrial as well as for domestic applications. All these automated appliances depend on electronic circuitry and hence on semiconductor devices. In modern power systems also, smart grid technologies implement smart control circuitry and smart meters. All these smart technologies adopt power electronic devices in their circuitry. Though power electronic devices play a major role in automation and aiding smart technologies, they silently spread subtle poison in the system like harmonic components. These harmonics may cause severe damage to the electrical and electronic appliances set up at customer end. So, it is necessary for any power system engineer to analyze the percentage of harmonics injected into the power network. So, he can able to measure it and try to mitigate its effect on the system to safeguard the appliances. Here, in this research, 10 bus radial and loop test networks are analyzed for the quantity of harmonic injection in them. The harmonic analysis is carried out by means of MATLAB Simulink and the results of both the networks are compared and plotted for different nodes present in the network. Harmonics are measured by using percentage total harmonic distortions and finally comparing the values for loop and radial suggesting that the loop network is more stable than the radial network.

articleTitle: Depression Prediction of Human Using Advanced Technology and Medical Imaging
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Depression is a typical condition that impacts 3.8 % in total population, with 5.0 % of adults and 5.7 % of oldaged persons suffering from it. Despite the fact that there are effective treatments for mental diseases, as well 75% of developing countries do not obtain them. In this paper, a smart gadget (a mobile phone or a robot) and medical imaging are used to identify depression without the need for clinical advice. By comparing the various elements of input and evaluating their performance, efficient technology can be used to forecast depression and ensure privacy.

articleTitle: Modelling of Smart Sensing Device for Sensitive Nanocluster

abstract: The report claims that nanocomposites have lately been used to create several smart gadgets with innovative characteristics. articleTitle: Machine Learning based Cancer Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Recently, recommendation systems have become more popular as a solution to society's challenges. As a subcategory of data mining, recommendation systems are useful tools. When it comes to senior patients who are in dire need, a priority-based recommendation system was created just for them. Even when their stay in the hospital is finished, elderly patients need further care for their health conditions. The proposed approach aims to enhance the feedback provided to patients once they return home from the hospital. Elderly individuals would be able to get recommendations and comments on healthcare services thanks to the proposed system. Their heartbeat and blood pressure values are used to provide a recommendation. A patient's smart band is utilized at the hospital to collect data for the user-based prediction system. Vital indicators (such as blood pressure and heart rate) of the elderly may be captured using this system. Precision and effectiveness for senior people's health are provided by the system. The severity of a patient's condition is determined by the band's variation.

articleTitle: Face Recognition Using Gradient Texture Features
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Nowadays,it is very important to recognize/identify a person for security reasons. A lot of people and organizations use biometrics for the identification of a person. Face recognition is one of the biometric identification techniques used a lot. The crucial part of the face recognition system is feature extraction and a good feature extraction technique has to be robust to noise and illumination. In this paper, we have proposed a new feature extraction technique using the texture of the image with the help of gradient features. In the proposed algorithm, at first, the face is detected using the MTCNN algorithm and the features are extracted from the detected face for the recognition purpose. Kirsch edge detection 8 kernels are applied to get edge response from the face detected and used ANOVA to find the edge similarity between each of the convoluted images of Kirsch edge response to get the final image as explained in the encoding face image section. Eigen values were obtained from the final image using Principal Component Analysis (PCA). The Chi-square method is used as a classification technique for matching the features of the test image with trained images present in the database. Here, the FERET dataset is used for training the model and testing the accuracy and we have achieved encoring results using the proposed method.

articleTitle: Realtime Facial Emotion Detection Using Machine Learning

abstract: This work aims to help the Narcotic officers for investigation purposes and it is also useful for robotics to identify human emotions. To handle these suspects, narcotics officer are using the old process of searching for the suspicious persons, taking them aside and proceeding with the investigation. This captures the person’s facial expressions, which will be notified to the needed persons to identify the suspect. articleTitle: Polarity Prediction on Product Reviews Based on Classification Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Sentiment analysis is analyzing customer’s opinion whether they are positive or negative on the product they purchased. The main objective of sentiment analysis is to categorize the data based on product review data’s polarity, it majorly consists of three steps document level, sentence level, aspect level. Sentiment analysis is mostly grounded on supervised learning in machine learning. Online product reviews are collected and analyzed. Online platform of shopping is very much helpful to gather review or opinion of customers to analyze. A sentiment sentence is categorized as positive or negative review based on the type of words used in the sentence, where the sentence is tokenized into separate English words to get analyzed. articleTitle: Multimodal Feature Selection for Android Malware Detection Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Android applications are fast evolving across the mobile ecosystem, yet Android malware is always emerging. Many researchers have looked into the issue of Android malware detection and proposed hypotheses and methods from various angles. Machine learning appears to be an efficient and promising technique to detect Android malware, according to existing studies. Our paper proposes a simple yet feasible approach to detect android malware using existing machine learning methodologies. We utilize a novel approach for considering multiple appropriate features called the Multivariate Feature Ranking algorithm that focus on deriving the most suitable features which is then applied to classifier models viz Decision Tree, Ada Boost ensemble method, Random Forest and Multi-layer perceptron. We were able to achieve an accuracy of 92% at a high level for the multi-layer perceptron model considering the Drebin dataset under experiment. Putting forth machine learning as the key aspect, we performed data acquisition, data pre-processing, novel feature selection methodology, followed by multiple classifier models that were evaluated and analyzed for further interpretation. The experimental results revealed that the modified feature selection method could help improve classification accuracy for baseline models, which indeed leads to future scope of improvement with advanced deep learning feature learning techniques.

articleTitle: A Proposed Approach for Identifying the Connotative Relationship of English Sentences and paragraphs using the NLP package of Python

abstract: Connotative Relationship of sentences and paragraphs provide a much-needed method that can extract the sentiment, emotion and knowledge of a writer. In this context the Natural Language Processing features and packages available in Python can provide a simple and unique solution for the extraction of inferred sentiments and emotions expressed by authors. In this research, an initial attempt has been made to extract the hidden sentiments of individual sentences and paragraphs from English text written by authors. Based on the work done it was found that even though the sentences of a paragraph were providing negative connotations the overall sentiment of the complete paragraph showed a positive sentiment and vice versa. Hence, it is inferred that analyzing and finding the overall sentiment of the paragraphs makes better understanding on the connotative meaning expressed by the authors in their textual writings.

articleTitle: SMC Controlled SAF for Reduction of Harmonics in DN
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Due to the proliferation of power electronic devices in our power system, the quality of power gets deteriorated mainly by harmonic injection in the system. Here, the power system is safeguarded by mitigating harmonics in a 10-bus distribution network using a shunt active filter. Here, the action of SAF is empowered by analyzing it in a closed path control system. The network is analyzed with conventional control techniques. Conventional control techniques like FOPID and SMC controllers are implemented here. The simulation is carried out by MATLAB Simulink. Here, the non-linear loads are injected at nodes 5 and 9. The propagation of harmonics in the network can be controlled by controlling the SAF at the end of the network. From the simulation results, it is proved that the Sliding Mode Controller is performing better than the Fractional order PID controller in mitigating the level of harmonics in the network. The proliferation of harmonics is measured by using the THD percentage. The THD Measured in the SMC controlled system at bus no.5 is 3.58% and at 9 it is 2.41% whereas the THD measured in the FOPID controlled network at bus no.5 is 3.91% and in bus no.9 is 3.26% respectively. Also, the real power of the system enhances from 0.8962MW(FOPID) to 0.9101MW(SMC)..

articleTitle: Fault Detection and Torque Control in BLDC Motor using AI

articleTitle: RemCheck: A Novel Drug Validator Application to detect fake Remdesivir, an Anti-Viral Drug for COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has turned out to be one of the dreadful disaster mankind has ever faced. With the subsequent waves of the pandemic setting in several countries, the number of cases being reported is quite alarming. People need to stay extremely vigilant and ensure strict adherence to social distancing, hand hygiene, and usage of personal protectives like masks, hand gloves and face shields. We need to be vigilant and keep a check on the circulation of fake Remdesivir drugs in the market amidst the pandemic. The study proposed development of a novel Drug Validator Application to detect fake Remdesivir drugs. This is done by scanning the carton or the vial of the Remdesivir drug through the dedicated Android application. This is further sent to the cloud server for processing. The AI model which runs in the cloud server evaluates the genuineness of the drug image. The report comprising the recommendation as Genuine or Fake is sent to the user through his/her registered mobile number and e-mail address. This application could curb the circulation of fake drugs in the market amidst the pandemic and could help in undertaking a real-time surveillance.

articleTitle: Bipolar Bidirectional DC-DC Converter for Microgrid Applications

abstract: Because of the disadvantages of using fossil fuels, there is a growing desire to increase the use of renewable energy systems.To meet the increasing energy demand DC microgrids are more efficient because they incorporate Renewable Energy Sources (RES) like solar, wind energy with electrical loads and energy storage systems. articleTitle: An Efficient Systolic Transformation FIR filter for Digital Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: FIR filters play an important role in digital systems. The FIR filter construction with optimum operating conditions is more important primary issues in (VLSI) real-time processing. These filters consist of a large number of ALU’s. The multiplication logic circuits in FIR filter wastes a lot of electricity. Power, area, and latency are the three most significant aspects of VLSI. This study analyzes several fixed point FIR filter designs and examines many performance metrics such as area, hardware implementation, and latency. The usual technique, systolic architecture, associativity conversion, and a mix of systolic and associativity designs are all taken into account. Using the above-mentioned architectures, we implemented 4, 8, and 16 tap filters and compared their performance requirements.

articleTitle: An Optimized Soft Computing Model Using Neural Network with ANT Colony Optimization Algorithm for Retinal Image Segmentation

abstract: The morphology of blood vessels in retinal fundus images is a good predictor of glaucoma, hypertension, and diabetic retinopathy. To discover and analyze any anomalies, retinal image analysis normally includes segmentation of the blood vessels, optical disc segmentation, and fovea segmentation. The consistency of retinal image analysis employed in modern ophthalmology diagnostic methods is influenced by the precision of retinal blood vessel segmentation. It is based on the idea that migrating from manual and traditional techniques to automated systems will improve accuracy by eliminating manual detection method faults while also lowering the tediously long time required for manual observation and detection. Therefore, there is a need to develop and build an effective and intelligent machine learning model for detecting and extracting retinal blood vessels. The suggested approach is unique in that it uses a nature-inspired technique called the ant colony algorithm to optimize the soft computing model. The proposed model's segmentation accuracy is projected in the final section of the analysis. It can be seen that the proposed technique is capable of improving the segmented output by 98.5 percent.

articleTitle: Human Voice Emotion Recognition Using Multilayer Perceptron

abstract: The Human Voice Emotion recognition system needs to extract features from speech signals. Time, frequency, and Cepstral domain features are among these features. Because the algorithm might affect the classification accuracy, choosing an effective regularization approach to generalize features is tricky. In our work we present the effect of the use of different regularization methods on language features to identify emotions. The dataset is collected from Ryerson Audio-visual Database where the emotional voices are the actors were filmed in eight different moods. Our research divides emotions into eight categories: neutral, calm, happy, sad, angry, afraid, disgusted, and startled. Speech indicators had been analyzed to classes Spectral assessment and characteristic extraction algorithms were used to extract the prosodic capabilities of speech formant frequencies, entropy, variance, minima, median, Linear Prediction Corrector (LPC). The emotional speech parameters are then extracted using Multilayer Perceptron Neural Networks (MLPNNs).

articleTitle: Cascaded ANN Controller for Grid Tied PV Based EV Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: A grid tied solar Electric Vehicle (EV) charging station, which aims at expanding the application of EVs in rural areas along with reduction of the over dependence on grid in case of cities, is the focus of this research work. Among various renewable sources of energy, the Photovoltaic (PV) system is the most viable solution for EV charging applications owing to its wide availability and ease of installation. Moreover, the ceaseless supply of power regardless of the innate intermittency of the PV system is achieved with the addition of a capacitor bank that serves the purpose of energy storage. The control methodology implemented for stabilizing and enhancing the output from the PV system includes a DC-DC quasi-Z source boost (QZSB) converter along with a cascaded ANN controller. The QZSB converter offers the benefits of increased voltage gain and reduced switching loss, whereas the cascaded ANN controller possesses the advantage of quick and accurate error compensation. In case of absence of power supply from both the PV and capacitor bank, the required power for EV charging is derived from the grid. The control of the single-phase Voltage Source Inverter (1φ VSI) connected to the grid is accomplished using an Adaptive Proportional Integral (PI) controller. The proposed grid tied solar EV charging station is implemented in MATLAB for verifying its performance.

articleTitle: Improved Accuracy of Plant Leaf Classification using Random Forest Classifier over K-Nearest Neighbours
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The aim of the study is to detect and classify healthy leaf and unhealthy leaf from the dataset provided by the Machine learning based novel Random forest algorithm. Materials and methods: A dataset of 2400 leaf images is created to train the random forest classifier which based on deep learning algorithms and is tested with 200 leaf images. Our proposed method includes steps of implementation such as dataset training creation and classification. The resulting statistics of affected and unaffected leaves simulated under random forest to categorize and separate the affected leaves and healthy leaf images with significance (p > 0.05). Result: On performing an independent samples t-test on the two similar groups, random forest achieved the accuracy, recall, precision and f1 score of 94.3%, 92%, 93% and 92% respectively compared to 87%, 84%, 81% and 83.5% by KNN algorithm. Conclusion: From this study, conclude the results of the detection in Random forest classifier appears to be higher than K-nearest neighbors.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Implementing the Application of Business Intelligence in Backwater Tourism Sector in Kerala

articleTitle: Implementation of Machine Learning Techniques for predicting Credit Card Customer action

abstract: When a consumer switches from one service provider to another, they are considered a churner. With an expanding number of fierce competitors inside the industry, important banks place a premium on client relationship management. A detailed and real-time credit card holder churn review is critical and helpful for bankers looking to retain credit cards. According to extensive research, maintaining an existing client is more than five times simpler than acquiring a new one. As a result, this research provides a strategy for predicting churns using a bank dataset. The "Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique" (SMOTE) was employed in this study to handle the unbalanced dataset. Randome forest, K closest neighbour, and two boosting algorithms, XgBoost and CatBoost, are used to forecast credit card user turnover. To improve accuracy, hyperparameter tweaking using grid search was performed. The testing results demonstrate that Catboost has an accuracy of 97.85 percent and outperforms the other models.

articleTitle: Data Aggregation of Wireless Sensor Network Using BEE Swarm Optimisation Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In a Wireless Sensor, sensors are randomly distributed across the network and identity. Utilizing methods enhances congestion control and scalability. One of the methods this algorithms utilises to save fuel is data transport. The constant drain of sensor battery, however, remains the most challenging issue. This has led to the investigation of a number of initiatives to enhance the network consumption of sensors data within a particular group. In this work, we built a honeybee swarm modeling framework and placed network devices in larger settings in order to minimise power usage in nodes with a sufficient reductions in replay rates and packet bottlenecks. Geographical hive swarm - based cluster is used to elect colony leaders and the WSN in its entirety in order to decrease latency and path interference. BSO ensures that photons reach the destination node more rapidly due to the decreased packet loss ratio. Analysis has revealed that the overall procedure uses less power and avoids packet recurrence due to waiting period.

articleTitle: Performance Monitoring and Dynamic Scaling Algorithm for Queue Based Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: It has developed over the last four decades, becoming an essential component of distributed systems. At its inception, it was designed to simplify application development by running on top of the operating system. It evolved into a tool for integrating data and applications across old and new systems, such as the usual object request broker architecture. The next step was to remove the application’s knowledge of a resource’s position on the network. As time went on, it became an important part of every distributed system and application out there. Service-oriented architectures (SOA), grid computing and utility computing are examples of SOAs that have been implemented in a wide range of applications. The performance and scalability of the IoT system are the focus of this article. We begin by providing a short history of queueing theory topics that are pertinent to our study. An evaluation of the scalability function suggested for IoT middleware is carried out via simulations of major performance and scalability characteristics.

articleTitle: Strong and stable Data communication Using Artificial Intelligence method in Mobile Ad-Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Using the idea of machine learning, the authors of this study provide a novel security mechanism for an Internet of Things model that is built on a mobile ad hoc network (MANET). The Black Hole Assault, also known as BHA, is among the most dangerous threats that can be found in a MANET. In this attack, the attacker node eliminates all of the data flow, which brings the efficiency of the model down. As a consequence of this, the development of a technique that is capable of shielding the system from the BHA node is required. This paper presented Ad-hoc On-Demand Distance Vector. It is a new advanced routing protocol which provides a combination of three different methods: ABC, ANN & SVM. The innovation of the developed framework is the integration of the SVM with the ANN, which allows detecting the attackers inside the identified path by using the AODV routing algorithm. This helps to prevent attacks. In this case, the ANN learning algorithm is used to train the model, while the ABC optimization algorithm and SVM are used to pick the training examples. The purpose of ABC is to improve the path that the transfer of information takes here between origin as well as the node at which it is ultimately received. The ABC algorithm's suggestion of the most efficient path, coupled with the attributes of each node, is then input into the SVMmodel. ANN determines if the node in question is a regular node or an intruder node by examining these qualities. The numerical simulation that was carried out in MATLAB demonstrates that the research that has been presented demonstrates an advantage in terms of Packet Delivery Ratio,latency, and throughput.

articleTitle: An Artificial Neural Network Classifier for palm Motion categorization based on EMG signal
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Electromyogram (EMG) signals have become more prevalent in recent years for the purpose of hand and finger motion identification. On the other hand, the majority of research have concentrated their attention on the arm and the entire hand, rather than on individual finger (IF) motions, which were thought to be more challenging. EMG-based classifications for hand and finger gestures are being developed using data mining algorithms in this study. Constant circuit arrangement is the basis for these algorithms. Ten individuals in good health were asked to make ten different hand/finger gestures, seven of which were IF movements. Three channels' worth of Electromyogram (EMG) signals was measured, and then each channel's worth of data was broken down into six time-domain (TD) characteristics. Artificial neural networks (ANN), a support vector machine, a random forest (RF) as well as a logistic regression were all used to create a set of 10 distinct gesture-specific classifications. There were a total of 18 qualities to choose from. For example, SVMs achieved mean precision of 0.840; ANNs were 0.840; SVMs were 0.866; SVMs were 0.877; and SVMs were 0.831.Each analysis of deviation and F-tests showed that now the artificial neural network (ANN) had the highest mean accuracy and the least inter-subject variation in efficiency, suggesting that individual variability in EMG data had the least influence on the ANN. We obtained a larger ratio of motions to channels than previous research that were comparable to ours using solely TD characteristics, which suggests that the suggested technique has the potential to increase the system's usability and minimize the amount of computing work required.

articleTitle: COVID-19 Identification and Detection from CT-Images using AI Based Ensemble Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The corona virus infection 2019 (COVID-19) has already reached every corner of the globe, leaving many areas with insufficient access to medical supplies. When contrasted to the RT-PCR test, computed tomography (CT) images are able to provide adequate a diagnosis that is both accurate and quick about COVID-19. In this regard, the focus of this research is on the development of an AI-based prediction classifier for the identification and categorization of COVID-19. Ensembles of DL models will be used in the AIEM-DC method in order to accomplish the method's primary goal of accurate COVID-19 detection and classification. In furthermore, a pretreatment approach that relies on Gaussian filtering (GF) is used in order to get rid of clutter and increase image resolution. In addition, for the purpose of extracting the features, a shark optimization method (SOA) is used, along with an array of deep learning methods. These models include recurrent neural networks (RNN), long short-term memory (LSTM), and gated recurrent unit (GRU). In addition, for the categorization of CT images, an upgraded version of the bat method combined with a multiclass support vector machine (MSVM) architecture is used. The originality of the study is shown by the development of the prediction classifier, which includes optimized parameter tuning of the MSVM model for COVID-19 categorization. The usefulness of the AIEM-DC method was tested using a benchmark CT imaging data set, and the findings indicated the potential generalization ability of the AIEM-DC methodology in comparison to the most current state-of-the-art techniques.

articleTitle: Blockchain Industry 5.0: Next Generation Smart Contract and Decentralized Application Platform

articleTitle: Application of Neural Network in the Prediction Models of Machine Learning Based Design
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research examines way to pass, among the most dynamic and quickly-evolving technology fields in the telecommunication sector. Apply sophisticated analytics to determine what mobile users' demands are, and then utilise that information to raise the effectiveness of "social wireless channels of communication."
